lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aap kripaa kar raakhahu har jeeu pohi na sakai jamakaal ||2||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, the Messenger of Death cannot even touch those whom You, in Your Mercy, protect. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਚੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾ ਓਹ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: teree saranaaee sachee har jeeu naa oh ghatai na jaai ||
lines.translation: True Is Your Sanctuary, O Dear Lord; it never diminishes or goes away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਗੈ ਓਹੁ ਜੰਮੈ ਤੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo har chhod doojai bhaai laagai ohu ja(n)mai tai mar jaai ||3||
lines.translation: Those who abandon the Lord, and become attached to the love of duality, shall continue to die and be reborn. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo teree saranaaee har jeeu tinaa dookh bhookh kichh naahi ||
lines.translation: Those who seek Your Sanctuary, Dear Lord, shall never suffer in pain or hunger for anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahi sadaa too sachai sabad samaahi ||4||4||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord forever, and merge in the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh har jeeu sadaa dhiaavahu jab lag jee paraan ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, meditate on the Dear Lord forever, as long as there is the breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee man niramal hoaa chookaa man abhimaan ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind becomes immaculate, and egotistical pride is expelled from the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saphal janam tis praanee keraa har kai naam samaan ||1||
lines.translation: Fruitful and prosperous is the life of that mortal being, who is absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man gur kee sikh suneejai ||
lines.translation: O my mind, listen to the Teachings of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam sadaa sukhadaataa sahaje har ras peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is the Giver of peace forever. With intuitive ease, drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mool pachhaanan tin nij ghar vaasaa sahaje hee sukh hoee ||
lines.translation: Those who understand their own origin dwell within the home of their inner being, in intuitive peace and poise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad kamal paragaasiaa haumai duramat khoee ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the heart-lotus blossoms forth, and egotism and evil-mindedness are eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa mahi eko sach varatai viralaa boojhai koee ||2||
lines.translation: The One True Lord is pervading amongst all; those who realize this are very rare. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਤੁ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee man niramal hoaa a(n)mrit tat vakhaanai ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the mind becomes immaculate, speaking the Ambrosial Essence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam sadaa man vasiaa vich man hee man maanai ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord dwells in the mind forever; within the mind, the mind is pleased and appeased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sad balihaaree gur apune vitahu jit aatam raam pachhaanai ||3||
lines.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, through whom I have realized the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanas janam satiguroo na seviaa birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those human beings who do not serve the True Guru - their lives are uselessly wasted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar kare taa(n) satigur mele sahaje sahaj samaaiaa ||
lines.translation: When God bestows His Glance of Grace, then we meet the True Guru, merging in intuitive peace and poise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee poorai bhaag dhiaaiaa ||4||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by great good fortune, the Naam is bestowed; by perfect destiny, meditate. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਣਾਏ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape bhaa(n)t banaae bahu ra(n)gee sisat upaai prabh khel keeaa ||
lines.translation: God Himself fashioned the many forms and colors; He created the Universe and staged the play.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਨੋ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kar kar vekhai kare karaae sarab jeeaa no rijak deeaa ||1||
lines.translation: Creating the creation, He watches over it. He acts, and causes all to act; He gives sustenance to all beings. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalee kaal mahi raviaa raam ||
lines.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord is All-pervading.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat poor rahiaa prabh eko guramukh paragat har har naam ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The One God is pervading and permeating each and every heart; the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is revealed to the Gurmukh. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gupataa naam varatai vich kalajug ghat ghat har bharapoor rahiaa ||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is hidden, but it is pervasive in the Dark Age. The Lord is totally pervading and permeating each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naam ratan tinaa hiradai pragatiaa jo gur saranaaee bhaj paiaa ||2||
lines.translation: The Jewel of the Naam is revealed within the hearts of those who hurry to the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪੰਚ ਪੰਚੇ ਵਸਿ ਆਣੈ ਖਿਮਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: i(n)dree pa(n)ch pa(n)che vas aanai khimaa sa(n)tokh guramat paavai ||
lines.translation: Whoever overpowers the five sense organs, is blessed with forgiveness, patience and contentment, through the Guru's Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਵਡ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੋ ਭੈ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: so dhan dhan har jan vad pooraa jo bhai bairaag har gun gaavai ||3||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed, perfect and great is that humble servant of the Lord, who is inspired by the Fear of God and detached love, to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur te muhu phere je koee gur kaa kahiaa na chit dharai ||
lines.translation: If someone turns his face away from the Guru, and does not enshrine the Guru's Words in his consciousness

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਆਚਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਪਉ ਸੰਚੈ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kar aachaar bahu sa(n)pau sa(n)chai jo kichh karai s narak parai ||4||
lines.translation: - he may perform all sorts of rituals and accumulate wealth, but in the end, he will fall into hell. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko sabad eko prabh varatai sabh ekas te utapat chalai ||
lines.translation: The One Shabad, the Word of the One God, is prevailing everywhere. All the creation came from the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਰਲੈ ॥੫॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh mel milaae guramukh har har jaai ralai ||5||6||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is united in union. When the Gurmukh goes, he blends into the Lord, Har, Har. ||5||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man gur apanaa saalaahi ||
lines.translation: O my mind, praise your Guru.
